description: This source file implements a GStreamer video sink element for Rialto, handling media source creation, property management, state changes, and event handling for video streaming within Rialto's media pipeline.

classes.name: RialtoMSEVideoSink
classes.description: A GStreamer sink element for Rialto that handles video streaming, media source creation, and property management.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state transitions for the Rialto video sink, attaching media player client and configuring stream info during state changes.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the caps, supporting different video formats and Dolby Vision profiles.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GStreamer events, particularly CAPS events, to attach media sources.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as video rectangle, max width/height, and frame step setting.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties like video rectangle, max width/height, and frame stepping.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles QoS messages, reporting processed and dropped buffers.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the video sink, setting up sink pad functions and QoS callback.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization, property registration, and supported MIME types setup.
